news.title: Less than half of directors are independent
news.body: No new directors have joined the board in the last 3 years. The company's board is composed of: No new directors. 3 experienced directors. 3 highly experienced directors. 2 independent directors (4 non-independent directors). Independent Director Kalpit Mehta was the last independent director to join the board, commencing their role in 2022. The following issues are considered to be risks according to the Simply Wall St Risk Model: Minority of independent directors. Insufficient board refreshment.

news.title: Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited Announces Resignation of Vijay Bankatlal Malpani as Independent Director, Member of the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee Effective February 28, 2026
news.body: Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited announced that Mr. Vijay Bankatlal Malpani has resigned from his position as Independent Director of the Company due to pre-occupation. Mr. Malpani served as an Independent Director and member of the Audit Committee and Nomination and Remuneration Committee at Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited. The effective date of resignation is February 28, 2026. His nationality is Indian.

news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹1.78 loss per share (vs ₹1.85 profit in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹1.78 loss per share (down from ₹1.85 profit in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹9.00m (down 39% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹714.0k (down 196% from profit in 3Q 2025).

news.title: Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited to Report Q3, 2026 Results on Feb 14, 2026
news.body: Sinnar Bidi Udyog Limited announced that they will report Q3, 2026 results at 12:15 PM, Indian Standard Time on Feb 14, 2026

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: EPS: ₹5.83 (vs ₹0.49 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: EPS: ₹5.83 (up from ₹0.49 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹17.0m (up 77% from 2Q 2025). Net income: ₹2.33m (up ₹2.53m from 2Q 2025). Profit margin: 14% (up from net loss in 2Q 2025).
